newsitem.title: JAPAN: YAMAICHI SHARES RISE ON MANAGEMENT CHANGES.
newsitem.headline: YAMAICHI SHARES RISE ON MANAGEMENT CHANGES.

text.p: Shares of Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd rose on Monday morning, buoyed by investor relief over the expected replacement of the brokerage's top executives, traders said.
At 0103 GMT, Yamaichi's share price was up 16 yen at 245 yen on trading volume of 1.875 million shares.
Yamaichi said this morning that it would hold a news conference at 11.30 a.m. (0230 GMT) regarding its top management.
Yamaichi said that the current chairman and president and their scheduled replacements would attend the news conference.
A Yamaichi spokesman said earlier on Monday that the brokerage's chairman, president and five vice presidents were likely to resign over a high-profile racketeer payoff scandal.
